name: Client TWRR with daily external flows
description: Daily return=(end value+outflow)/(prior value+inflow)-1; returns link geometrically.
user_problem: Deposits and withdrawals should not masquerade as investment return.
benefit: Separates performance from capital flows under opening-day deposit/end-day withdrawal timing.
uncertainty: Source inspection only; tests not run.

name: External-flow classification
description: Account deposits/removals and portfolio delivery in/out are external; trades, income, taxes and fees are not flow neutralized.
user_problem: Transactions mix funding and portfolio activity.
benefit: Class-driven return treatment.
uncertainty: Source inspection only; tests not run.

name: Zero-base handling
description: Zero prior value plus inbound flow sets daily return to zero; nonzero residual change adds a warning.
user_problem: First funding can make return undefined.
benefit: Avoids division by zero and flags unsupported value movement.
uncertainty: Source inspection only; tests not run.

name: Performance scopes
description: Factory APIs support client, account, portfolio, portfolio plus reference account, classification, investment and security.
user_problem: Users need returns for comparable portfolio slices.
benefit: Shared calculation logic across filters.
uncertainty: Source inspection only; tests not run.

name: Quote-only security and benchmark index
description: SecurityIndex chains daily quote-value changes and anchors to client accumulated return at the first quote date; it has no transaction cash-flow arrays.
user_problem: Instrument quote performance differs from an investor realized return.
benefit: Provides a quote-path comparator for securities and benchmarks.
uncertainty: Price-only index: dividend payments and held-security trade cash flows are handled by separate security-performance calculations.

name: Quote-only benchmark annualized return
description: SecurityIndex.getPerformanceIRR builds only negative start and positive end quote valuations, converted on endpoint dates.
user_problem: Benchmark quote growth can be mistaken for an investor-specific return.
benefit: Defines an endpoint-only annualized quote growth metric.
uncertainty: Applies to SecurityIndex quote path; held-security IRRCalculation includes transaction and dividend cash flows (PP-019).

name: Daily portfolio valuation
description: Applies dated transactions, values cash and shares at requested date, converts into term currency.
user_problem: Transaction history alone is not market value.
benefit: Date-specific total valuation.
uncertainty: Source inspection only; tests not run.

name: Missing security quote valuation
description: Zero resolved quote falls back to last applied transaction gross price per share.
user_problem: Unpriced assets otherwise appear valueless.
benefit: Transaction-derived estimate.
uncertainty: Estimate is not market quote.

name: Security quote lookup
description: Uses exact or latest prior quote; requests before first quote use first quote.
user_problem: Weekends and gaps need defined valuation.
benefit: Supports daily value with stale/prehistory fallback.
uncertainty: No stale-age limit apparent.

name: FX lookup and missing data
description: FX uses exact/latest prior rate; pre-first date uses first observation. EmptyExchangeRateTimeSeries returns rate 1 for any date.
user_problem: FX calendars have gaps or no provider data.
benefit: Keeps conversion available, but missing data can silently imply parity.
uncertainty: CurrencyConverterImpl also falls back to one when lookup is empty; providers/callers not exhaustively traced.

name: Annualization and period boundaries
description: Final cumulative return annualized as (1+return)^(365/actual interval days)-1; client end clipped to today.
user_problem: Different duration periods are difficult to compare.
benefit: Time-normalized rate over available dates.
uncertainty: Source inspection only; tests not run.

name: IRR actual-day discounting
description: NPV discounts dated cash flows by elapsed actual days/365.
user_problem: Investor return depends on timing, unlike TWRR.
benefit: Money-weighted annual return.
uncertainty: Source inspection only; tests not run.

name: IRR solver limits
description: Bisection only when endpoints bracket; otherwise Newton starts at 5%, max 500 steps, no convergence status.
user_problem: Cash flows may have no, multiple or negative roots.
benefit: Standard case solution, but uncertain edge outcomes.
uncertainty: May throw or yield non-finite or poor result.

name: FIFO and moving-average cost
description: Both cost methods expose charge-included monetary basis and charge-excluded gross basis. FIFO relieves old lots; average cost removes rounded pro-rata basis.
user_problem: Gain depends on lot method and cost treatment.
benefit: Realized/unrealized cost views.
uncertainty: Owner matching, transfers and fractional rounding require edge tests.

name: FX vs security gains

uncertainty: Minor-unit rounding applies.
